// Fixture: an injected GATE-SEMANTIC CheckType-keying site that is ABSENT from
// the CheckTypeConsumerCatalog (SPEC-041 CLM-023). The completeness guard must
// DISCOVER this site (an identity comparison that drives a scope/exemption
// decision) and FAIL because no catalog entry covers it — proving the guard is
// not a tautology. This file is .go.txt so it is NOT compiled into the package;
// the guard scans it as a discovery-scope source fixture.
package fixture

import "github.com/backstop-ai/backstop-core/pkg/check"

// dropMe is a gate-semantic keying site: it keys a scope/exemption decision on
// CheckType identity. An unlisted site of this shape is a dropped gate step.
func dropMe(v check.Violation) bool {
	// Gate-semantic: a ProjectWide/scope decision keyed on CheckType identity.
	return v.Pass == check.CheckTypeBuild
}
